ICAP::uri
Description
The ICAP::uri command sets or returns the ICAP request uri.
Syntax
ICAP
::
uri
ICAP
::
uri
<
uri
>
ICAP::uri
Gets the ICAP request uri
ICAP::uri <uri>
Sets the ICAP request uri.
